title: A direct summand of a quasi-coherent module sheaf is quasi-coherent
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal M$ and $\mathcal N$ be sheaves of modules over the structure sheaf of $X$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and suppose $\mathcal M$ is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent]. If there are module morphisms $\iota : \mathcal N \to \mathcal M$ and $\pi : \mathcal M \to \mathcal N$ with $\pi \circ \iota = \mathrm{id}_{\mathcal N}$, then $\mathcal N$ is quasi-coherent. Thus quasi-coherence is inherited by a retract (direct summand) of a quasi-coherent module sheaf.
